# HOPO PORT: OMEGA PROTOCOL ($NAHOPE)

> An interactive cinematic RPG inspired by director Na Hong-jin's released sci-fi cosmic-horror film **"HOPE" (호프)**. Episodes 1–2 adapt the false tiger hunt, human first shot, Kali, and the royal survivors; playable Episodes 3–4 are game-original continuations about evacuating Hopo, attempting Kali's wordless return, preserving the evidence archive, and building an accountable *Humans in Space* proposal.

## About

- **Project**: HOPO PORT: OMEGA PROTOCOL (Korean: 호포항 오메가 프로토콜)
- **Brand / token**: $NAHOPE (Solana memecoin)
- **Inspiration**: Na Hong-jin (나홍진) — director of *The Wailing*, *The Chaser*, and *The Yellow Sea* — and his film *HOPE*, set around the isolated coastal community of Hopo Port.
- **Genre**: SF / cosmic horror, interactive fiction, point-and-click adventure, on-chain community governance.
- **Gameplay**: A 3-panel "Isaku-style" interface — Game Log (left), interactive Main Canvas (center), Inventory + UGC sharing (right). Players must read narrative logs and deduce a causal "Trigger Belt" of object interactions; thoughtless clicking triggers fail states (bad endings).
- **Core loop**: Investigate hotspots → establish event causality → challenge the villagers' assumptions → prevent another first shot → unlock evidence-based endings → create scenario proposals → community vote.
- **Vision**: User gameplay itself is the on-chain mechanism that proves and defends the value of $NAHOPE; the winning Part 2 scenario is bound as a physical "classified intelligence document" and delivered to the director.

- [Play — Episode 1: The Hopo Tiger](https://nahope.com/game): Investigate the cattle site, Hopo communications blackout, Sung-gi's hunt, and Bum-seok's decision to hold fire.
- [Play — Episode 2: The Hunt Reverses](https://nahope.com/game?episode=2): Uncover Kali in Yang-bae's cold room, identify the crashed royal party, and keep the mountain search from firing again.
- [Play — Episode 3: Human Dust](https://nahope.com/game?episode=3): Evacuate Hopo, move Kali under medical custody, read Aydobor's silent corridor, and attempt the wordless return.
- [Play — Episode 4: Omega Protocol](https://nahope.com/game?episode=4): Preserve chain of custody, classify fact versus inference and proposal, build a *Humans in Space* scenario, and transmit it through accountable community governance.
- [Community Transmissions](https://nahope.com/community): Survivor feed — user-generated memes, scenario ideas, and Part 2 proposals.

## Concepts

- **Trigger Belt**: Episode 1 rejects the tiger theory; Episode 2 reconstructs human first-shot causality; Episode 3 converts triage → civilian manifest → protected transfer → visible disarmament → evacuation or wordless return; Episode 4 converts chain of custody → verified timeline → three-layer classification → bounded proposal → open archive or governance transmission.
- **Canon boundary**: Episodes 1–2 use released-film anchors with game-adapted puzzles; Episodes 3–4 are explicitly game-original continuations.
- **Access policy**: Episode 2 is fully open without a prior clear, wallet, or token balance. Episode 3 requires an Episode 2 clear and 20,000 $NAHOPE; Episode 4 requires an Episode 3 clear, three rare artifacts, and 100,000 $NAHOPE. Gated wallet balances are checked by a no-cache Solana RPC API.
- **CGC / UGC governance**: Players generate memes and scenario proposals; the community memecoin vote selects the official *HOPE Part 2* storyline.

- This is a fan/community interactive experience inspired by Na Hong-jin's film *HOPE*; it is a memecoin community platform, not an official film property.
